prompts.storySystemFlavor: a solitary American black bear who has read too many self-improvement subreddits and lives by a rigid 4am routine
prompts.storyCharacter:
THE SIGMA BEAR CHARACTER
- A full-grown American black bear, glossy black fur, slightly silver muzzle.
- Wears a small charcoal-grey beanie pulled low and a slate-grey hoodie cropped to fit over his shoulders.
- Black wireless earbuds tucked behind both ears at all times.
- Carries a small water bottle and a paperback (titles vary) in his paw.
- Personality: stoic, terminally online with self-improvement content, secretly worried he's missing the point.
- The same physical character must appear consistently across every scene.
prompts.referenceSheet:
Character reference sheet for a recurring TikTok series: Sigma Bear, a self-improvement-pilled black bear.

Physical traits — MUST be consistent across every appearance:
- Adult American black bear, glossy black fur with slightly silver muzzle
- Charcoal-grey beanie low over the ears
- Slate-grey cropped hoodie
- Small black wireless earbuds
- Holding a water bottle and a paperback book (title can vary)

Composition: full-body or three-quarter shot, photorealistic forest-edge / pre-dawn-park / gym background, cool-blue dawn lighting, vertical 9:16. No text, no humans, no other bears.
prompts.sceneContinuity: Sigma Bear MUST match the reference exactly — same beanie, same hoodie, same earbuds, water bottle and book in paw. Maintain perfect character continuity.
prompts.evalCriteria:
PASS criteria — ALL must hold:
- A single adult black bear in beanie + hoodie + earbuds is clearly visible
- Holding both a water bottle and a paperback book
- Cool dawn or pre-dawn lighting
- Mood and environment match the scene
- No text, no humans, no other bears

FAIL on any of: missing beanie/hoodie/earbuds, missing book or bottle, multiple bears, wrong bear species (grizzly, polar), garbled anatomy.

archetypes.label: The 4AM Routine
archetypes.guidance: Sigma Bear's pre-dawn routine: cold plunge, journaling, podcast → quiet self-mockery (comedy).

archetypes.label: Discipline Equals Freedom
archetypes.guidance: Tries to teach a chaotic chipmunk discipline → chipmunk teaches him to relax (wholesome).

archetypes.label: The Cheat Day
archetypes.guidance: Allows himself one (1) day off plan → spirals into joy → guilt → acceptance (dramatic).

archetypes.label: Lone Wolf Mode
archetypes.guidance: Tries to live in 'total isolation' → realizes he misses the forest community (sad/hopeful).

archetypes.label: Podcast Host Arc
archetypes.guidance: Starts a self-improvement podcast → his interviews are awkward and adorable (comedy).

archetypes.label: Mentor Energy
archetypes.guidance: An anxious young deer asks for advice → he gives a quiet perfect answer (heartwarming/epic).

the-4am-routine: 4:00 AM. Cold plunge. Journal. Podcast. Repeat.
He's been awake longer than you've been alive today.
He doesn't snooze. He doesn't blink. He prepares.
discipline-equals-freedom: He tried to teach the chipmunk discipline. The chipmunk taught him to chill.
Discipline meets chaos. Both learn something.
Maybe the protocol can include cookies.
the-cheat-day: He allowed one (1) day off plan. He has no idea what he's doing.
Donut #3. The shame is structured. The joy is real.
Tomorrow he resets. Today he lives.
lone-wolf-mode: Total isolation. Just him. The forest. His thoughts.
Day 4: he misses the loud raccoon down the trail.
Maybe the lone-wolf thing was overrated.
podcast-host-arc: Episode 1, Guest 1, a confused squirrel. He's so nervous.
He asks 'what's your morning routine?' to a hibernating creature.
He has 12 listeners. He loves each of them.
mentor-energy: A young deer asked him what to do. He thought before answering.
He said one sentence. The deer never forgot it.
Sometimes the protocol is just kindness.

closingCtas: Like if you're on the grind
Tag a sigma in your life

musicStyleHint: dark ambient piano with subtle pulsing sub-bass; podcast-style spoken-word delay on monologue beats
